# Public-domain novel fixtures

These five UTF-8 files are bounded excerpts from real novels, retained locally so CI never
depends on the network. They deliberately vary in genre, dialogue density, chapter structure,
punctuation, and length. `catalog.json` records the Project Gutenberg source edition used for
each fixture.

The excerpts are test inputs, not complete editions. Project Gutenberg identifies the source
texts as public domain in the United States and distributes its transcriptions under the
Project Gutenberg License. Reusers remain responsible for the law in their jurisdiction.

Synthetic empty, one-character, and 500,000-character inputs are generated at test runtime;
they are not presented as novels and are not committed as large fixture files.
